mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% MoM and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both increase and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls during late-cycle expansion and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
